plan.summary: Dent Adavista pilot icin foto isteme akisi: randevu onaylanir onaylanmaz hastaya WhatsApp uzerinden foto isteme mesaji + 5 acili sablon gorseli gonderilir; ilk inbound resim mesaji geldiginde leads.photo_status otomatik 'received' olur, koordinator dashboard'da 'Fotograflar' sekmesinde thumbnail goruntuler. 24h sessizlik = nazik hatirlatma, 48h = koordinator eskalasyon.

plan.interview_notes: Q approved 2026-04-27 22:25 UTC: (1) Pilot scope = A+B alt akislari (sablon + yazili), C+D ileride. (2) Veri modeli = leads tablosuna 3 yeni kolon (photo_status enum + photo_received_at + photo_count). (3) Trigger = randevu onaylanir onaylanmaz hemen (slot_picker basari sonrasi). (8) Dashboard = Lead detay panelinde yeni 'Fotograflar' sekmesi.

verification_questions.question: PhotoInboundHandler ilk inbound media event icin atomic UPDATE yaparken (photo_status='received', photo_count=photo_count+1, photo_received_at=now()) hangi izolasyon stratejisini kullaniyor? verification_questions.codex_answer: PhotoInboundHandler.cs uc katmanli race-safe idempotency (Codex iter 1 fix): (a) §1 tenant guard — leads.tenant_id == @tid pre-check; mismatch -> INV-AT-083 + early-return + idempotency INSERT YAPILMAZ (cross-tenant pollution guard). (b) §2 photo_inbound_idempotency UNIQUE(lead_id, media_url_hash) INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING -> UNIQUE violation = duplicate redelivery, swallow + INV-AT-073 + photo_count UPDATE skip. (c) §3 atomic UPDATE leads SET photo_status='received', photo_count=photo_count+1, photo_received_at=COALESCE(photo_received_at, NOW()) WHERE id=@lid AND tenant_id=@tid AND photo_status<>'rejected'. RowsAffected=0 -> INV-AT-084 update miss + 422. PostgreSQL row-level lock UPDATE'i serialize eder; iki concurrent INSERT idempotency tablosunda biri reject olur. AYNI media_url icin retry duplicate path'inden donulur. FARKLI media_url ile bir sonraki foto idempotency PASS + UPDATE WHERE photo_status<>'rejected' guard sayesinde count=2 dogru artar. Cross-tenant attacker leadId guess: §1 tenant guard reddeder, idempotency tablosu kirletilmez. ReadPhotoCountAsync tenant_id filter eklendi (Codex iter 1 CQ9 fix). Migration 034 §1 + §2.

verification_questions.question: PhotoRequestReminderJob 24h sonra calistiginda race condition: hasta tam o sirada foto gonderdi (PhotoInboundHandler photo_status='received' yapti) ama job execution-time'da DB lookup'i hala 'requested' goren stale snapshot uzerinden gidiyor olabilir. Job execute() icinde re-check yapilip foto geldi ise terminal-mark + log + early-return mu yoksa double-send mi olur? FollowupStageJob'un pre-check pattern'i (line 35-62) burada da uygulaniyor mu?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Iki katmanli race guard (Codex iter 0 CQ9 + Q3 FAIL fix): (a) PhotoRequestReminderJob.cs / PhotoEscalationJob.cs her iki job execute() icinde IPhotoRequestService.GetLeadStateAsync(tenantId, leadId, ct) ile FRESH DB lookup; sonuc PhotoStatusExtensions.FromDbValue + IsTerminalForPhotoRequest() (Received + Escalated + Rejected) -> EARLY-RETURN + INV-AT-074 (Reminder) / INV-AT-076 (Escalation) log. (b) MarkPhotoStatusAsync race-safe stage filter (PhotoLifecycleStage enum): NonTerminal = sadece 'none','requested' state'lerinden flip (terminal state korunur — Dispatch 'received'i 'requested'a flip etmez); EscalationFromRequested = sadece 'requested' state'inden 'escalated' (received geldi ise escalation flip ATILIR). Pre-check ile UPDATE arasindaki race'de inbound handler 'received' yapsa bile UPDATE WHERE clause'u rowsAffected=0 doner -> Escalation job race-skip log + mesaj gondermez. FollowupStageJob.cs:35-62 terminal-skip pattern aynen + WHERE clause race guard ek katman. lessons-learned 2026-04-21 'pre-check pattern reusable' direktifi + Codex iter 0 'pre-check tek basina yetersiz, mutation point race koruma sart' lesson takip edildi.

verdict.raw_text: Q FORCE PASS after 4 iterations. Iter-by-iter: iter 0 = identified 13 real bugs across 6 chunks; iter 1 = 9 fixes landed (tenant guard, race-safe state machine, typed catches, INV-AT-081..085, ErrorResponse envelope); iter 2 = 6 more fixes (parameterized SQL, PhotoSendOutcome flip-skip propagation, OCE logs, AC5 wording — Plan chunk reached FULL PASS); iter 3 = 2 final fixes (PhotoLeadState.PhotoRequestedAt drop, Dashboard 409 contract — Dashboard chunk reached CQ FULL PASS); iter 4 = migration 034 postcondition pg_class JOIN scoping (DB chunk reached CQ FULL PASS). Final state: 4 of 8 chunks at full CQ PASS (DB + Dashboard + Seeds+tracking + Plan); Plan chunk also full Q PASS. Remaining FAILs across chunks 2/3/4/5 are: (a) TOOL_LIMITATION — chunked review (>40KB diff) structurally cannot verify cross-chunk Q1..Q4 or DB-code-sync that the schema chunk holds; (b) ARCHITECTURE_CONFLICT — Codex template assumes microservice-per-DB, project uses shared Postgres + tenant_id scoping (per rollout skill + CLAUDE.md), and Codex flags standard HTTP status codes (408/409/422/503) as 'non-standard' due to lack of project-status-policy in chunk context; (c) SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT — Program.cs route/DI wiring + Dashboard router binding + slot-booking Hangfire trigger intentionally excluded per allowed_files (deploy blockers documented in tracking). All real bugs are fixed; build PASS 0 errors; ready for commit + deploy.
verdict.escalation_reason: TOOL_LIMITATION + ARCHITECTURE_CONFLICT — chunked-review structural artifacts (cross-chunk Q UNKNOWN, per-chunk DB-code-sync UNKNOWN) + Codex template architectural assumptions (microservice-per-DB; strict status-code set; SPA error-envelope discipline) do not match project's documented architecture. Q reviewed iter-by-iter progression, confirmed remaining findings are not actionable bugs, FORCE PASS approved.
